samples.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one transparent enemy sprite for the existing dark-fantasy game. The four input images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY, never subjects to copy. Match their chunky, stepped pixel blocks, dark warm near-black outlines, muted cream/bone, rust brown, antique brass and charcoal steel palette, and upper-left highlights. Single complete isolated creature/object, three-quarter battle view toward screen left, no environment or ground shadow. It should look drawn at roughly 112x140 logical pixels and enlarged with nearest-neighbor to about 1120x1400: hard square 10px blocks, 1–2 block outline, approximately 3–7 broad shade bands, no dithering or smooth shading. Use a small coherent palette (up to 32 colors). Fully transparent empty background, fully opaque sprite, no translucent effects or antialiased edges. No lettering, UI, border, watermark or labels. Do not add traits, props or weapons absent from the following source description. Weakness elements are metadata, not visual powers.
Source: design/enemies.json enemy abyss_hound; family 14 심연 사냥 (Abyss hunt), common zone; mob, front-row assault. Exact appearance: 여러 짐승의 뼈와 털이 엉겨 붙은 검은 개 — a black dog with bones and fur of several beasts tangled together. Actions: bite, bite, howl. Draw ONE dog-shaped abyssal creature: low canine body on four paws, tangled coarse black fur with exposed pale animal-bone fragments embedded among fur; recognizable single canine silhouette, single head. No armor, collar, chains, rider, horns, wings, fire or invented magical glow. Menacing but no blood or gore. Modest mob size, broad low silhouette; keep full paws and tail in frame.

visual_review.method: Opened sample-sheet.jpg and all three final PNGs directly using view_image
observations: All seven sprites compared at one 14% source-pixel scale and aligned lower silhouettes.
Warm bone/brass highlights, dark charcoal outlines and upper-left lighting are shared with the v2 references.
Dog, chained book and armored shield/spear mass have distinct silhouettes; mob < chief < boss size hierarchy visible.
New PNG edges are deliberately harder and coarser than soft, irregular generated v2 edges because of the required strict 10px grid, 32-color palette and binary alpha.
Hound at 14% is visibly smaller and loses fine bone details; the canine silhouette remains readable.
Boss shield symbols absent from source were removed via image_gen correction.
limitations: This is an art review sheet; game integration belongs to branch A and was not changed.
No claim of exact native-grid/palette equivalence: the v2 originals contain 50k–71k foreground RGB colors and partial alpha.
Owner approval is pending; other 97 enemy subjects were not generated.
